camel_example: aliyun nlb AddServersToServerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Servers.1.ServerType Ecs --Servers.1.ServerId 'i-bp67acfmxazb4p****' --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui****' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
description_en: Adds backend servers to a Network Load Balancer (NLB) server group
description_zh: 向网络型负载均衡服务器组中添加后端服务器
name: AddServersToServerGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the server group
parameters.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en:
The description of the server.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
fields.help_zh:
服务器描述信息。

长度限制为2-256个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、中文、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The port used by the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 65535. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 0 is used.

If the all-port forwarding feature is enabled for the server group, you do not need to specify a port when you add a backend server. In this case, the default value 0 is used, and NLB forwards traffic to the backend server based on the frontend request port. You can check whether the all-port forwarding feature is enabled by querying the AnyPortEnabled field returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445895.html operation
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器使用的端口。端口范围0~65535，不填则默认传入端口值0。

当服务器组开启全端口转发后，添加后端服务器时无需指定端口（默认传入0），NLB将按照前端请求端口转发流量至后端服务器。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445895.html接口返回的**AnyPortEnabled**字段查询是否开启了全端口转发
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The ID of the backend server.

If the server group is of the Instance type, this parameter specifies the resource ID of an Ecs, Eni, or Eci resource.

If the server group is of the Ip type, this parameter specifies an IP address
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci的资源ID。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en: The IP address of the server. This parameter is required when the server group is of the Ip type
fields.help_zh: 服务器IP地址。当服务器组为Ip类型时，必须指定IP地址
fields.name: server_ip

fields.help_en:
The backend server type. Valid values:

Ecs: an ECS instance.
Eni: an elastic network interface (ENI).
Eci: an Elastic Container Instance (ECI).
Ip: an IP address
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：Ip地址
fields.name: server_type

fields.help_en: The weight of the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100. If the weight is set to 0, no requests are forwarded to the backend server
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器的权重，取值范围：0~100。默认值为100。如果设置权重为0，则不会将请求转发给该后端服务器
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The list of backend servers.

You can specify up to 200 servers in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务器列表。

单次调用最多支持传入200个服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance is deployed. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: prechecks the request without adding the servers. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the precheck, an error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the precheck, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会添加服务器。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The response for adding backend servers

JobId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task

ServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the server group
